content: Let a line L passing through the point $\mathrm{P}(1,1,1)$ be perpendicular to the lines $\frac{x-4}{4}=\frac{y-1}{1}=\frac{z-1}{1}$ and $\frac{x-17}{1}=\frac{y-71}{1}=\frac{z}{0}$. Let the line L intersect the $y z-$ plane at the point Q . Another line parallel to L and passing through the point $\mathrm{S}(1,0,-1)$ intersects the $y z$-plane at the point R . Then the square of the area of the parallelogram PQRS is equal to $\_\_\_\_$ .
